name: body_impact
description: A body hit: a dull fleshy WHUMP for someone getting punted — a cloth slap tick on contact, a band-passed flesh thump just after, and a deep chest slam under it (brown noise low-passed at 110 Hz + a 95-45 Hz dropping sine, ~0.47 s), through a punchy finish bus. Knobs: heft (weight), flesh (mid band).
prompt: a sound for body impact when you get hit by a car and ragdoll; doomy: too weak/shallow — deepened sub, longer tail, heavier gains Nov 21

name: car_horn
description: A cab horn: a sour dual-tone electric HONK (saw tones ~415/495 Hz, seeded ±25 Hz per-take offset so takes read as different cabs), a brass blat burst and pitch scoop on the attack, grit through tanh drive, a horn-flare resonance, hard stop. Knobs: length (hold), edge (drive + top end).
prompt: new car horn sounds for the friendSLOP NYC cab traffic; doomy: too synthetic — brass blat burst + pitch scoop + saw tones added Nov 21

name: mj_hee_hee
description: MJ-style staccato falsetto "hee hee", two hits, second higher
prompt: create a "hee hee" MJ sound in sounder for the MJ character

name: mj_hee_hee_falsetto
description: Michael's falsetto "hee hee": two short notes, each with a breathy h and an upward flick; the first about 720 Hz, the second a minor third lower (about 615 Hz) and longer.
prompt: redo the hee hee sound in a way that would fit the michael character; add as a variant, the 2nd note down in pitch from the first

name: mj_whoo
description: Michael's whoop "whoo!": a breathy h, a scoop up to about 640 Hz, held with vibrato, then falling away.
prompt: make a few other sounds along those lines of that character; whoo is too high pitched

name: mj_uh
description: Michael's grunts "uh! uh! uh!": three pressed chest notes near 350 Hz, the middle one a touch higher, the last flicking up to falsetto as it is cut off.
prompt: make a few other sounds along those lines of that character; uh is too short / needs repetition

name: mj_aah

prompt: make a few other sounds along those lines of that character; aah is too high pitched

name: mj_ee_hee
description: Michael's "eee-hee": a long rising falsetto "eee" near 800 Hz, then a short "hee" a minor third lower.
